dishes.name: Welsh
dishes.desc: Toast and ham under a beer and cheddar sauce, baked and topped with a fried egg, often with Maroilles. Lille's signature estaminet dish.

dishes.name: Tarte au Maroilles
dishes.desc: A tart of strong Maroilles cheese and cream, served warm with chips or salad. A classic of Lille's estaminets.

dishes.name: Carbonade flamande
dishes.desc: Beef slowly stewed with beer, onions and gingerbread. A Flemish estaminet favourite in Lille.

dishes.name: Potjevleesch
dishes.desc: A cold terrine of chicken, pork, veal and rabbit set in aspic, served with chips. A speciality of French Flanders.

dishes.name: Filled waffle
dishes.desc: A thin waffle filled with vanilla or brown sugar syrup, a Lille sweet since the 19th century. Sold in bakeries and boutiques.

dishes.name: Moules-frites
dishes.desc: Mussels in white wine served with chips, the signature dish of the nearby Flemish coast. Served at the Braderie de Lille and in many brasseries.
